## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues when applicable.

## Verification

List checks run and their results, including checks not run and why. For bug fixes, describe regression coverage; for UI changes, include relevant screenshots or browser checks.

## Compatibility and risks

Note any changes to document formats, units, tolerances, dependencies, configuration, or deployment requirements. Write “None” if there are none.
